The Okafors’ Big Box

It doesn’t matter what’s in it. It’s a box, and it’s ours.

Read this aloud

A van stops outside Number 31. The courier staggers up the path with the biggest box any of you have ever seen. Every cat on the wall goes very still. Mrs Okafor signs for it in the doorway while her son Tayo bounces behind her. She drags it into the hall. Somewhere in the kitchen a dog barks once, sleepily, and stops. Biggest score of the year, and it’s sitting in the hall.

House Standard · Patience 8 · The prize big delivery box (Large) · Gone at the start of round 13 · Den Tayo's room

Who lives here Mrs Okafor, Tayo, Noodle

For four cats. With three: Patience 9, gone at the start of round 15, Lights Out at the end of round 17, 3 Cattitude each. With five: Patience 7. The Robbery Tracker does this for you.

The Okafors’ house has a hall, a living room, a long kitchen with a dog door, and a garage with its side door left ajar. Upstairs are the bathroom, the landing and Tayo’s room. Mrs Okafor will unpack the box in the living room, and then she’ll flatten it for the recycling. The gang wants it before that — the whole thing, out of the house and all the way back to the hideout.

How it plays

  • This is a carrying job. Get three cats onto the box, then haul it room by room: every move of the box is a roll, and a human watching takes a die off a Sneaky haul and adds to the Mood.
  • Waiting it out won’t work for long: at the start of round 5 Mrs Okafor comes for the box, and if it isn’t where she left it, she starts Searching.
  • Tayo is a kid: Sweet rolls he sees fill Cuddle twice as fast. Distract his mum, not him.
  • Noodle sleeps in the kitchen, right on the way out. Don’t wake him — or befriend him; he’s soft.
  • If someone Shoos a cat out through the garage, the side door shuts — and that’s the box’s only way out. Reopen it from inside (Streetwise, Hard).

The Prize Clock

WhenThe prize
Start of round 1Mrs Okafor puts it in the hall and stays there this round. No roll to get at it.
Start of round 5Mrs Okafor puts it in the living room and stays there this round. No roll to get at it.
Start of round 13Gone — if the gang isn't holding it.
End of round 15Lights Out: any cat still inside is pinched.

The rooms

RoomTemptsNotes
HallBox SitterFront door (behind Mrs Okafor): big, Sneaky, Hard; or Sweet, round 1 only
Living roomLap Cat, Hunter, Knocker—
KitchenFoodie, CuriousDog door: normal, no roll
GarageHunter, ClimberGarage side door, ajar: big, no roll
LandingClimber—
Bathroom—Bathroom window (over the shed roof): normal, a climb (Small things only), Sneaky or Savage, Tricky
Tayo's roomBox Sitterthe Den

Ways: Hall–Living room (big), Hall–Kitchen (big), Kitchen–Garage (big), Hall–Landing (normal), Landing–Bathroom (big), Landing–Tayo's room (big).

The box is Large: it takes three cats to move (or two with a Chonky one), and it only fits through Big ways. The only Big way out after round 1 is the garage side door, through the kitchen.

Who lives here

Mrs Okafor (Grown-up)

Attention 1 · starts in the hall. Routine (d6): 1–3 stays put; 4 Kitchen; 5–6 Living room.

Tayo (Kid)

Attention 1 · starts in the living room. Routine (d6): 1–2 stays put; 3–4 Tayo's room; 5 Living room; 6 Kitchen.

Kid: doubles Cuddle steps from any roll they see.

Noodle (Dog)

Rating 2 · starts in the kitchen, asleep. Routine (d6): 1–2 stays put; 3 Hall; 4 Garage; 5 Living room; 6 sniffs one room toward the nearest free cat inside. Soft: Sweet can befriend it.

The getaway

  1. The side gate, left on the latch — Streetwise or Savage.
  2. Next door's terrier — Savage or Sneaky or Sweet; rating 1 (it takes 1 die off).
  3. The garage roofs — Savage or Sneaky, Tricky. The Satin Paws hang about here, and nick any loot that's dropped.
  4. The main road — Streetwise or Savage.

Then the hideout. The loot is 3 pieces.

Cred (Chapter 9): the catnip stash is Tayo’s catnip fish, under the bed (tayo's room). The Satin Paws have tagged the garage.

Running The Okafors' Big Box in Foundry

The quick way: open the Robbery Tracker (the cat button on the token controls) and press Play a ready-made game. Pick this house and the cats (the ready-made gang, your players' own cats, or both): one click brings in this house's map from the Ready to Play compendium, the gang and the residents, puts everyone on the map and starts the robbery.

Give each player a cat (right-click a cat → Configure Ownership) and press Begin round. The tokens follow the robbery by themselves; drag one if you like, and the next change puts it back where the robbery says.

Or by hand:

  1. Open the Robbery Tracker (the cat button on the token controls) and choose Start a robbery: pick this house and the gang. Every cat starts outside, with its starting Cattitude.
  2. Begin round runs the Prize Clock and, if anyone can be tempted, whispers you one-click Tempt buttons.
  3. Players move and act from the tracker (or roll from their cat sheets). The roll dialog fills in the Knack, help, Difficulty, the pet and who is watching; the card offers Push and Accept, and you can flip Seen.
  4. End round rolls the house's turn in the open: pets, noise, routines and Searching, holders, then Finding it.
  5. The house part ends at Lights Out, or at the end of a round when no free cat is left inside and the prize is out, eaten or gone (or when you press End the robbery because the gang runs for it). Any cat still inside is pinched.
  6. The getaway follows in the same tracker: the loot is shared out, each cat rolls over the next obstacle (help a friend and go over together; a Flop drops loot), and End the getaway round brings the warden on and corners the stragglers, who dodge or go in the van. When everyone is home or pinched, the loot is counted and the outcome is posted.
  7. Cred scores itself: any cat can Tag its room (one tag a room for the gang), the catnip stash tempts every cat in its room (or a cat gets into it on purpose) and gives that cat the zoomies, and the rivals wait on the getaway. The tracker keeps each cat's Cred (with − and + for you), and the outcome card names the Cat's Whiskers.

Every automation can be switched off in the system settings. The residents of this house are in the Residents compendium; the tracker works without them.
